other_failure_modes.name: Gradient-based optimization of a non-differentiable metric
other_failure_modes.description: The agent uses SLSQP, a gradient-based optimizer, to tune ensemble weights for ROC AUC. Since ROC AUC is a step function based on prediction ranks, its gradient with respect to weights is zero almost everywhere. The optimizer will fail to compute meaningful numerical gradients and terminate immediately, effectively leaving the weights at their initial unoptimized values.

other_failure_modes.name: Feature engineering test data leakage
other_failure_modes.description: The agent concatenates train and test features into a single dataframe and calculates group-level statistics (e.g., mean credit limit by education level) on this combined dataset. Passing this global reference dataframe to the feature engineering function leaks information about the test set distribution into the training features.

summary: The agent provides a structurally strong solution with extensive feature engineering, rigorous cross-validation, and an attempt at ensemble optimization. However, it introduces test distribution leakage by computing group-by statistics on the combined train and test sets. Additionally, the ensemble weight optimization uses a gradient-based solver (SLSQP) on a non-differentiable metric (ROC AUC), which will silently fail to optimize the weights.
